name: Nijisaki Ayame
source:
Ayame is rare maid, who is desirable by various noble dynasties. She's not from talkative ones, but works hard and responsibly.
Ayame is mysterious girl. She seems more mature, than she looks. She's seeking something or someone special...

[spoiler]Ayame is actually an incarnation of [url=http://vndb.org/c17788]Melissa[/url].[/spoiler]
